evidence.observation: Heater temperature implausibly high (~405-413 °C) and monotonically drifting while T703 reboiler stays ~49 °C
Reflux flow collapsed from ~0.65 to 0.004-0.3 while distillate FT703 rose to ~0.7-0.8, i.e. reflux split lost
Reboiler at ~50 °C with essentially flat column profile — no boilup/separation gradient
Pressure drop near zero/noisy negative, consistent with negligible vapor traffic

args.missing_evidence: Distillate/bottoms composition (GC) measurement, heater power setpoints and T701 sensor cross-check, and confirmation of reflux valve/pump state to distinguish sensor fault from real loss of reflux
